description: This file defines the Subtraction operator class within a matrix library, providing methods to subtract matrices or scalars from a matrix object.

classes.name: Subtraction
classes.description: Represents a subtraction operator for matrix operations, capable of subtracting matrices or scalars.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the subtraction operation, determining whether to subtract a matrix or scalar based on the input.

methods.description: Subtracts a matrix from the current matrix, ensuring matching dimensions.
